# The helper agent, written by `agentbreeder new agent --from-spec` on 2026-11-13.
#
# Published versions are immutable. To change the prompt (or, the same way, the evals in
# src/evals/), edit src/prompt/, bump `version:` in its manifest.yaml, run
# `agentbreeder registry publish src/prompt` and change the ref below; then build and release.
# `agentbreeder next` shows where the project is and what to run.
kind: agent
schema_version: 1
name: helper
runtime: runtime/adk@1.4.0
model: {alias: chat, reasoning: low, max_model_calls: 3}
prompt: {ref: prompt/helper-prompt@0.1.0}
evals: {ref: eval/helper-evals@0.1.0, threshold: 0.5, retries: 2}
mcp:
  - ref: "mcp/github@1.0.0"
    tools: ["get_me", "list_issues"]
traces: none        # this stack has no trace collector
agent_events: none  # and no event log for the agent

# Local backing services for the helper agent: Postgres and the LiteLLM model gateway.
# Written by `agentbreeder new agent helper --from-spec` on 2026-11-13.
# `agentbreeder services up --environment dev --env-file FILE` starts them; FILE holds
# GEMINI_API_KEY=... and GITHUB_MCP_TOKEN=... (mode 0600). See docs/services.md.
kind: stack
schema_version: 1
name: helper
services:
  postgres:
    ref: service/postgres-pgvector@1.1.0
    with: {databases: [app, litellm]}
  litellm:
    ref: service/litellm@1.0.0
    with: {config: stack/litellm/config.yaml}
    wire: {database-url: postgres.databases.litellm}
mcp:
  github: {ref: "mcp/github@1.0.0"}
environment:
  gateway: litellm
  models: ["chat", "judge"]
  ceilings: {budget_usd: 5, rpm: 60}
  bindings:
    DATABASE_URL: {ref: postgres.databases.app}
  eval_database: {ref: postgres.databases.app}
  agents:
    helper:
      sponsor: you@example.com   # who answers for this agent
      review_by: "2027-05-12"     # the gate refuses deploys after this date
      candidate: true            # release tests a candidate before production
      mcp: {github: [get_me, list_issues]}

model_list:
  - model_name: "chat"
    litellm_params: {model: gemini/gemini-3.8-flash, api_key: os.environ/GEMINI_API_KEY}
  - model_name: "judge"
    litellm_params: {model: gemini/gemini-3.8-flash, api_key: os.environ/GEMINI_API_KEY}
litellm_settings:
  turn_off_message_logging: true   # spend logs keep tokens/cost, not prompts or replies
general_settings:
  master_key: os.environ/LITELLM_MASTER_KEY
  database_url: os.environ/DATABASE_URL
  store_prompts_in_spend_logs: false

kind: prompt
name: helper-prompt
version: 0.1.0
description: The helper agent's system prompt.

You are helper.
Be brief.

kind: eval
name: helper-evals
version: 0.1.0
description: Cases for the helper agent, from the agent builder.
judge: {alias: judge}
cases: golden.jsonl

{"id": "hours", "turns": ["When is support open?"], "expect": {"must_match": ["9"], "tools_include": ["github_get_me"]}, "reference": "9am to 5pm Pacific."}
{"id": "unknown", "turns": ["Stock price?"], "reference": "It doesn't know."}

# docs/services.md.
kind: stack
schema_version: 1
name: helper
services:
  postgres:
    ref: service/postgres-pgvector@1.1.0
    with: {databases: [app, litellm]}
  litellm:
    ref: service/litellm@1.2.0
    with: {config: stack/litellm/config.yaml}
    wire: {database-url: postgres.databases.litellm}

  bindings:

    litellm_params: {model: "ollama_chat/llama3.2:3b", api_base: http://host.docker.internal:11434}
  - model_name: "judge"
    litellm_params: {model: "ollama_chat/llama3.2:3b", api_base: http://host.docker.internal:11434}
litellm_settings:
  turn_off_message_logging: true   # spend logs keep tokens/cost, not prompts or replies
general_settings:
  master_key: os.environ/LITELLM_MASTER_KEY
  database_url: os.environ/DATABASE_URL
  store_prompts_in_spend_logs: false
